name: @hasna/workflows
description: Universal graph workflow app — graph language (start/step/decision/while/end), three-table store, session WAL, daemon with claims/leases, four lane adapters (claude/codex/cursor/grok), and a full CLI on four surfaces

scripts.build: bun run build:runtime && bun run build:types
scripts.build:runtime: rm -rf dist && bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --packages external && bun build src/mcp/index.ts --outdir dist/mcp --target bun --packages external && bun build src/serve/index.ts --outdir dist/serve --target bun --packages external && bun build src/index.ts src/service.ts src/handlers.ts src/agent-tools.ts src/types.ts --root src --outdir dist --target bun --packages external
scripts.test:pg: WORKFLOWS_TEST_DATABASE_URL="${WORKFLOWS_TEST_DATABASE_URL:?point it at a throwaway Postgres; the live-PG gate must not pass without one}" WORKFLOWS_REQUIRE_POSTGRES=1 bun test src/db/pg-live.test.ts
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run artifact-scan
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && bun run build

author: Hasna
